content.text: Come quickly and look at this news headline, a rising starlet's red carpet mishap?
These are her high-definition photos from the red carpet, and the dress looks a bit odd.
@Chloe You're right, the embroidery on picture 2 looks quite rough.
@Mia The headline in Figure 1 is really interesting; everyone is discussing her outfit.
This is the haute couture original runway image of the brand, and the material of the skirt hem is noticeably different.
Indeed, the glossiness is quite different; Figure 3 appears to have a better texture.
@Mia I noticed that the waist in Figure 2 lacks boning support, making it appear very soft.
@Una Yes, the authentic version has boning support at the waist area, making it much more structured.

@Chloe Everyone says she's wearing a knockoff, no wonder the material looks off. The purpose of the boning isn't just to keep the skirt stiff; it mainly helps shape the waistline and prevents wrinkles around the waist when walking. High-end couture gowns rely on this to maintain their structure.
@Mia's fans are still defending her, this is really...
Look at that male celebrity in the background; he seems to be secretly laughing.
@Mia This expression is absolutely perfect; I wonder what's going through his mind.
Everyone, take a look at this embroidery detail—it's quite rough.
@Mia This embroidery really doesn't seem up to haute couture standards; it seems a bit disappointing to the audience.
I found the same item on Taobao, it's exactly the same!
@Vivi Look at this price, no wonder there are such embroidery issues.
@Mia Speaking of details, fans are still working hard to control the narrative regarding this mishap.
The authentic ones she used to wear were nothing like this; the difference is quite noticeable.
@Mia Yeah, the authentic products from the past really had more texture and stiffness.
However, when it comes to stiffness, the authentic version has boning support at the waist, while hers is soft.
@Chloe So it was an issue with the fishbone support, which confirms it's definitely a counterfeit.
Has anyone noticed the expression of a certain male celebrity on the red carpet? He's secretly smiling.
@Nina, that male celebrity you mentioned might have noticed the awkwardness of the dress.
Indeed, his expression may reflect his inner thoughts on the matter.
Everyone, take a look at this fan's reaction—still managing the comments.
@Mia They really don't give up, even though it's already so obvious.
Usually, fans use this method to protect their idols.
But look at this picture, the male celebrity in the background is smiling. Does he know some inside information?
@Chloe Wow, his expression is really intriguing. Does he also find this matter amusing?
I think he might know something, otherwise he wouldn't have smiled so conspicuously in front of everyone.
Perhaps he couldn't help but laugh when he saw the hemline issue? But other reasons cannot be ruled out either.
If he really knows the inside story, that would be interesting. Perhaps he has a good personal relationship with that actress?
The brand has already issued a statement. Take a look at this. It seems they also want to distance themselves.
@Chloe This statement came out really fast; they probably don't want to get too involved.
It's actually quite normal for the brand to do this, as such incidents have a significant impact on their reputation.
That's right, the brand's stance is very clear, but it also makes things more complicated. What do you all think?
Look at this secretly photographed celebrity couple, what does everyone think?
@Mia These two look really close, especially with their gestures.
@Una, did you notice the rings on their hands?
Yes, looking at the details of this ring, I guess it's a couple's set.
@Una This ring has a very unique design, it looks like the style of a luxury brand.
I think this ring might be from this brand.
@Chloe It really is from this brand, just look at the official website images and you'll know.
It seems this celebrity couple really has something special; the rings weren't chosen casually.
But when it comes to the male star who was secretly laughing, do you think he might know some inside information?
The expression of secretly laughing is indeed quite intriguing; perhaps it's a comment on the red carpet incident?
@Una I think it might be because he's related to some incident; his expression gave him away.
The smirk on his face makes me wonder if he did it on purpose; there might be a story behind it.
Everyone, check out the trending topics on Weibo—they're all discussing this.
@Mia This trending topic is indeed quite interesting; that male celebrity actually made it onto the list too.
@Vivi Yeah, I've been wondering why he's been snickering. Could it be related to the recent gossip?
@Nina I think he might know some insider information that isn't widely known, especially regarding his relationship with that actress.
@Chloe Could it be that they have some secrets they don't want the fans to know? Is this perhaps the reason he's secretly laughing?
@Una That might be the case. I've noticed he's been more active on social media lately.
@Mia He might be intentionally stirring up topics to increase his exposure.
@Vivi This strategy is indeed very effective, especially in such trending events.
@Nina We should continue to pay attention to their interactions; there might be new discoveries.
@Chloe I'll keep an eye on their social media to see if there are any more clues.
@Una This kind of gossip is truly addictive; I hope there will be new revelations.
@Mia Yeah, this kind of entertainment news always sparks everyone's interest.
@Vivi I wonder if there will be more news about them in the future?
@Nina I believe there must be, after all, they are currently the focus of everyone's attention.
@Chloe Let's look forward together and see what surprises are in store next.
